title: Starting Coordinates
description: A shipment created through the CSV bulk-import side door should still start its journey exactly where the manifest says it's coming from — no different than one booked through the normal wizard.
successCondition: Import a single valid row via POST /api/admin/shipments/import with a specific originLat/originLng. The row is accepted. Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` for the new shipmentId confirms current_lat and current_lng exactly equal origin_lat and origin_lng — the import path sets the starting position the same way Module 2's booking flow does.
hints: importShipmentsCsv (apps/api/src/modules/admin/service.ts) sets currentLat/currentLng from the row's own origin fields when creating the shipment, mirroring booking's service.
The customerEmail column must reference an existing account with role "customer" or the whole row is rejected — use a seeded demo customer.
